svg.aria-label: One frame of Glimt and its background threads. The UI thread's frame_ui takes what threads sent (poll_background), turns keys and clicks into an Action, runs it, and draws. Actions and drawing start threads or send them jobs: folder listing, folder watch, file jobs, writer threads, thumbnail and decode workers; the remote listener takes commands from other processes, which App::logic takes before each frame and also while the window is hidden. Every thread answers over an mpsc channel held as Receiving and calls request_repaint, so the next frame picks the answer up.
svg.title: One frame and the threads

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: One frame, and the threads around it
Black arrows: the UI thread starts work or sends a job. Blue: answers coming back over mpsc channels, taken at the start of the next frame.
UI thread: eframe calls App::ui, which runs frame_ui (main.rs)

a setting, a mark, keywords → write_later, write_sidecars
dialogs and windows: preferences_window, prompt_dialog, pan_view, …

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: paints the decoded textures; decode_size sets the box to decode to
The frame ends. egui draws the next one on input, or when a thread
calls ctx.request_repaint(). A frame does no O(n) work over the list.
While work runs, Working::new(&self.busy) counts it, and the busy
pointer shows (App::working). The count drops when the thread ends,
also when it panics. An answer sent through an AnswerSender keeps a
pointer of its own until the window has handled it.

a stat of each open folder a second, 1,000 subfolders → changed_tx → relist_later
File jobs (files/file_ops.rs; progress, and Stop inside a file)

g.text: sidecar_writer: keywords and stars, in the order they were made

Thumbnail workers spawn_thumbnailers, one per core
thumbs::thumbnail: freedesktop cache, or made by decode::decode_shrunk
skip a job no longer in kept_images · decode() to the box asked · histogram

g.text: an accept thread, serve() in a thread per client (16 at most)
→ remote.rx → receive_remote in App::logic, also while hidden

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: held as Receiving<T>, read with take / next / latest / wait (Took::Gone once if a thread died)
each sender then calls ctx.request_repaint(), so a frame runs to take the answer
Nothing heavy runs on the UI thread. Not drawn, but built the same way: the EXIF reader, the exif: index, folder sizes, Open With, mounts,
Check Images, Find Duplicates, printing, tools, the look-up of a path opened, and the list's sizes and dates (the_window_thread_never_waits_for_the_disk).
